messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: High 5xx rate detected on apigw-edge-eu (ingress L7) — 502/504 spike. Trigger: 5min error rate > 8%. Pager: oncall-alex :rotating_light:
oncall-alex: seeing it. Confirming traffic surge + backends 504s. My team picking this up.
sre-lee: jumping in. Any region-specific notes?
oncall-alex: eu-west-1 primarily, small bump in na-west too. Error rate ~12% on the last 5m.
eng-runtime-maya: pulling traces now. Initial look: increased queue depth on edge pool, some upstream connection resets to backend-pool-a.
prod-lead-noah: customer-impact: a few large customers reported timeouts in dashboards, telemetry shows spike in frontend retries. Estimating ~35% of requests see degraded latency or 502.
customer-success-ana: flagged two customers already, prepping status note. ETA 10m for initial comms after triage.
infra-jamie: I'm checking infra alarms — network paths look healthy, no ASG scale events. Edge instances CPU fine.
sre-lee: can we confirm if this is fanout -> one misbehaving downstream? Are all upstreams healthy?
eng-runtime-maya: quick grep of logs shows repeated: `upstream reset by peer` from backend-pool-a on keepalive connections. Also seeing `502: connection closed while reading response` in edge logs.
oncall-alex: ok. Mitigation idea: temporarily route a % of traffic away from backend-pool-a to backend-b and enable fail-fast on route for 10m. Thoughts?
sre-lee: agree. Add circuit breaker rule to avoid prolonged attempts. Set `max_retries=1` and `timeout=5s` for the affected route.
eng-runtime-maya: ready to push a route patch. Patching edge routing now. Command: ```curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/routes/edge123/patch -d '{"condition":"backend==pool-a","action":"split:80/20->pool-b","cb":{"retries":1,"per_try_timeout_ms":5000}}' -H 'Auth: token'```
eng-runtime-maya: applying... :hourglass_flowing_sand:
incident-bot: Deploy bot: rollout started for route patch (deploy-id: dp_2026_03_15_01).
eng-runtime-maya: deployed. I can see traffic shifting ~22% to pool-b. Error rate dropped to ~6% in the edge polyline.
oncall-alex: good. Keep monitoring. If errors drop under 3% we can expand shift.
sre-lee: also enabling short-term connection reset alerting to catch recurrence: `edge->upstream reset > 5%`.
infra-jamie: investigating backend-pool-a nodes — tail logs show a spike of worker thread OOM-ish churn around the same timeframe. Might be a memory pressure leading to killed connections.
prod-lead-noah: schedule a follow-up to diagnose root cause, but we need to stabilize customer traffic first.
eng-runtime-maya: increasing split to 60/40 (pool-b/pool-a) as a temporary measure. Doing a canary ramp.
oncall-alex: monitoring: error rate 3.1% now. Latency slightly increased but steady.
customer-success-ana: sending customers an interim note: "We're seeing transient 502/504 errors affecting some requests. We've implemented traffic routing to reduce impact and are investigating root cause. We'll update in 30 minutes." :email:
incident-bot: Pager: no longer firing for the primary rule (5m error rate).
sre-lee: leaving a TODO: capture heap profiles from pool-a nodes and check recent config rollout that touched connection handling.
infra-jamie: collected profiles and core logs, pushing to /internal/incidents/7001234567/artifacts.
prod-lead-noah: nice work. Plan: keep 60/40 until we validate fixes on pool-a. Postmortem owner: eng-runtime-maya. RCA kickoff in 2h.
oncall-alex: handing off to oncall backup (sre-lee) for monitoring. I'm off for short break. :coffee:
sre-lee: taking over monitoring. If we see any regression, we revert the split and escalate to infra.
eng-runtime-maya: adding follow-up notes: potential causes: memory leak in backend service after recent deploy, keepalive misconfiguration, or high request payload causing worker saturation. Will coordinate with backend team.
customer-success-ana: will follow up with customers after RCA.
prod-lead-noah: resolved for now. Closing this thread after final checks. :white_check_mark:
oncall-alex: thanks everyone. Great quick coordination.
